records.context: Matplotlib's default is DejaVu Sans, and asking for "Helvetica" on a Linux machine that has no Helvetica silently falls back to it too, so figures would be drawn in a different face from the interface and in a different face on each machine.
records.label: spacr.figure_font#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Matplotlib's default is DejaVu Sans, and asking for "Helvetica" on a Linux machine that has no Helvetica silently falls back to it too, so figures would be drawn in a different face from the interface and in a different face on each machine.
records.translation: Matplotlibs standard är DejaVu Sans, och att begära "Helvetica" på en Linux-dator som saknar Helvetica faller också i tysthet tillbaka på det, så figurer skulle ritas med ett annat typsnitt än gränssnittet och med olika typsnitt på varje dator.

records.context: spaCR ships Open Sans (``spacr/resources/font/open_sans``), so the face is always present. It must also be registered: setting the rcParam alone names a family matplotlib may not have, and a name it cannot resolve is a silent fallback rather than an error. Adding the bundled files to the font manager makes the name resolve on a machine where Open Sans was never installed.
records.label: spacr.figure_font#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: spaCR ships Open Sans (``spacr/resources/font/open_sans``), so the face is always present. It must also be registered: setting the rcParam alone names a family matplotlib may not have, and a name it cannot resolve is a silent fallback rather than an error. Adding the bundled files to the font manager makes the name resolve on a machine where Open Sans was never installed.
records.translation: spaCR levererar Open Sans (``spacr/resources/font/open_sans``), så typsnittet finns alltid. Det måste också registreras: att bara sätta rcParam namnger en familj som matplotlib kanske inte har, och ett namn som den inte kan lösa upp blir en tyst reserv snarare än ett fel. Att lägga till de medföljande filerna i teckensnittshanteraren gör att namnet kan lösas upp på en dator där Open Sans aldrig installerades.
